final_answer:
MEMORANDUM (Privileged). To: R. Hadley. From: P. Deshpande. Date: Oct 29, 2025. Re: Ridgeline/Pinnacle $475M revolver, Graymark Oct 24 markup (GM) v. our Sept 18 draft (D) and Aug 22 term sheet (TS). Tiers: C=Critical, S=Significant, A=Acceptable.

1. BOTTOM LINE
GM reopens the mandate deal: it departs from TS on all four "hills" (ECF distribution basket; June 30, 2028 deadline/115% cushion; EBITDA addbacks; no sponsor guaranty) and ~25 other agreed points. I count 58 discrete changes (19 C, 29 S, 10 A); GM's "~90" is unreconciled. Worst: (i) Completion Guaranty, which Side Letter (SL) s.5(c) bars and the s.5(b) cap (about $120M; $73M free after $47M existing) cannot absorb; (ii) tax distributions at 25% v. 37.6%; (iii) FY2027 leverage lands exactly on the new 4.00x covenant. Treat GM as a reopening; escalate before replying; do not confirm Sponsor "engagement" on the guaranty (GM cover letter).

2. DOCUMENT INTEGRITY RED FLAGS
- GM's "original" text is not our Sept 18 draft. Untracked differences found: D 5.10(f)-(g) (no delay LDs/no guaranty) and 6.11(c)-(d) (no capex/liquidity covenant) missing; D 5.10(b) "commercially reasonable efforts" became absolute; 90-day force majeure extension (D 9.01(l)) missing; EBITDA (e) lost "whether or not consummated"; Tax Distribution protections (any leverage; outside baskets; true-up) missing; ECF definition rebuilt (starts from Adjusted EBITDA; no Tax Distribution deduction); judgment default 60 to 30 days and insurance carve-out dropped; cross-default/judgment extended from Guarantors to all Subsidiaries; CoC clause (c) and 100% Guarantor language dropped. Articles renumbered (GM 6.10/7.06/8.01(m) v. D 6.11/6.06/9.01). Action: full machine comparison; counter against D; demand GM confirm no untracked changes.
- Entity name: GM and SL caption/signature call the Fund "Crestview Infrastructure Partners Fund III, LP"; D, TS and SL definitions say "Aldersgate". Exhibit E names Crestview as guarantor. Confirm legal name.
- GM comment says Borrower's schedule targets Q4 2027; TS says Redstone base case is April 2028. Obtain Redstone's current schedule.
- Five folder documents belong to other matters (Brazoria/Cornerstone transmittal, commitment letter and project model; Ridgeline Natural Resources RBL agreement and markup; Ashworth Dane RBL playbook). Set aside; flag misfiling/confidentiality.
- Fee letter (D 2.09(c), Sept 18) is not in the file; $185M notes' indenture (lien/debt covenants) not reviewed.

3. CATEGORY ANALYSIS (GM v. D/TS; counter/fallback)

PRICING
P1 Grid (S): GM margins +50 bps at every level, and breakpoints tighten 25 bps (2.25/3.00/3.75x v. 2.50/3.25/4.00x); GM's comment ("tightened by 25 bps") understates it. At SOFR 4.33%, all-in D 6.58/6.83/7.33/7.58% v. GM 7.18/7.43/7.93/8.18% (+60 bps same tier; +85 to +110 bps with tier migration). Counter: TS grid; fallback TS margins, breakpoints +0.25x.
P2 SOFR floor 1.00% (S): not binding now but TS agreed 0%. Model: $1.8M-$7.1M extra interest if SOFR falls to 0.5-1.0%. Fallback: 0.00%; never above 0.25% and only for margin trades.
P3 SOFR Adjustment 10 bps (S): TS "no CSA". Reject. Model: GM pricing totals about $19.6M extra interest/fees over FY2025-30 ($6.5M in construction).
P4 Commitment fee 50 bps (S): TS 37.5. Hold; fallback 42.5 stepping to 37.5 above 50% utilization (about $0.6M/yr at full undrawn).
P5 D error (S): D 2.08 fixes initial margin at Level III (300 bps) although TS expects Level I (225) at closing leverage (1.65x TS; 2.19x pro forma model). Fix in counter.

STRUCTURE
Accordion $125M to $75M, plus 3.50x pro forma test, "reserve report", lender ROFO (S): TS agreed $125M, covenant compliance, no forced lenders. 3.50x is unusable during construction (peak 3.1-4.2x). Counter: $125M; fallback $100M, covenant compliance, no ROFO.
Maturity Dec 15, 2029 v. 2030 (S, high): TS records five-year approval and "four-year never discussed". Notes ($185M) mature Mar 15, 2029; model has about $250M drawn at end FY2029. Counter: 2030; fallback extension option.
Closing date/FX clause (A).

FINANCIAL COVENANTS
F1 Max leverage 4.00x (C): TS says 4.50x gives only 0.30x over the 4.2x peak; 4.00x is breached by the parties' own projection. Model FY2027: 540/135.1 = 4.00x (zero headroom); EBITDA 5% lower gives 4.21x; debt +$25M gives 4.18x. Counter 4.50x. Fallback 4.50x to 12/31/2028, then 4.25x.
F2 Step-up (S): 5.00x/2 quarters/$50M becomes 4.50x/1 quarter/$75M. Hold; fallback 5.00x one election.
F3 ICR 3.00x (S): FY2027 3.32x (3.24x if actual fee is used); a 10% EBITDA miss breaches. Hold 2.50x; fallback 2.75x post-completion.
F4 Minimum Liquidity $35M "at all times" (S): TS: none. Undrawn availability counts but depends on MAE-conditioned draws. Delete; fallback quarterly test at $20M.
F5 Capex cap $200M (S): TS: none; contradicts the purpose. Projection tab: FY2026 Lateral $165.1M + $38.0M other = $203.1M, over the cap (model tab's $185M uses $20M maintenance); one-year carryforward is the only cushion. Delete; fallback exclude Construction Budget capex.

EBITDA (stress test per model, $000s)
E1 Projected-revenue addback deleted (C): FY2026 EBITDA 149.9 to 127.5; FY2027 175.5 to 136.9 (-23%). Leverage FY2026 2.60x to 3.06x; FY2027 3.08x to 3.94x; ICR 4.91x to 3.83x. Reject; fallback: keep for contracts with investment-grade/credit-supported shippers, 12-month cap on pre-COD revenue, 25% of EBITDA cap, CFO certificate.
E2 Sponsor fee addback deleted (C): TS says Pinnacle agreed. Model deducts $1.5-1.8M, but SL s.2(a) fixes the fee at $5.0M from 2025, +2.5% yearly ($5.25M FY2027). Corrected FY2027 GM leverage is 4.10x (breach). Also D's $5M cap is exceeded from FY2026. Restore, with cap indexed. Client must reconcile model v. SL.
E3 Non-cash cap $10M (S): FY2028 projection is $10.0M, FY2030 $11.0M; TS unlimited. Reject; fallback $20M.
E4 Transaction-fee cap $7.5M (S): TS uncapped; facility/accordion/acquisition costs can exceed. Fallback $15M.
E5 Extraordinary losses $8M (A; fallback $10M). 
E6 Synergies 15%/12 months (S): TS 25%/18. Fallback 20%/18.
E7 QoE report for pro forma acquisition adjustments (A if limited to >$25M deals, "reasonably satisfactory", any recognized firm).

SECURITY
S1 Federal/state lease and ROW carve-out deleted, all real property mortgaged (C): legal, not commercial; federal ROW grants are generally not assignable or encumberable without agency approval (e.g., 43 C.F.R. Part 2800 and 30 U.S.C. 185; not independently verified within budget). TS records Pinnacle agreed on Marchetti's own advice. Restore carve-out (D 7.01(iii)); fallback commercially reasonable efforts post-closing to seek consent where available, never a CP/default; fix title rep (GM 3.12) that warrants ROW title.
S2 $15M mortgage threshold deleted (S): fallback $5M, ROW easements excluded from mortgage list.
S3 DACAs on all accounts, CP (S): fallback $1M threshold, carve-outs (payroll, tax, escrow), 90 days post-closing.
S4 CP for assignment of all material contracts (S): D 7.01(f) excluded. Fallback: Mountaineer firm transportation agreements only, collateral assignment, shipper consents on efforts basis post-closing.
S5 Permit pledge (A if "to the extent assignable without governmental consent"); intercompany subordination/pledge (A).

RESTRICTED PAYMENTS (Sponsor priority; SL s.7 allows Fund to withdraw support)
R1 Basket (C): D greater of $30M or 50% ECF at 3.50x; GM fixed $15M at 3.00x, ECF deleted. Model FY2025-30 distributions $136.5M to $60.0M (-$76.5M; about -$61.5M excluding FY2025). TS: first distributions expected 1H FY2029; 3.00x delays 12-18 months; TS Sponsor need $40-55M/yr. Model note that the ECF alternative bypasses the leverage test is wrong (D 6.06(b) applies 3.50x to both). Counter D. Fallback: $30M/50% ECF, 3.50x, tested post-completion at 3.75x.
R2 Fee ban (C): D $5M/yr outside basket; SL accrues unpaid fees at 5% compounded. Fallback: payable if no payment/bankruptcy EOD, accrual allowed, subordination.
R3 Tax distributions 25% hypothetical (C): D 37.6%, uncapped, any leverage. SL s.3(b)-(c): rate must not be below actual; priority; LP Agreement breach risk. SL illustration: Aldersgate shortfall $8.7M on $95.2M income (that is EBITDA; model FY2024 pre-tax $47.7M gives about $4.4M; about $9M/yr by FY2029). Reject; fallback formula "highest combined marginal rate", CFO certificate, floor 37%.

CHANGE OF CONTROL (EOD)
CoC1 (C): 35% to 51% (A alone; Sponsor holds 72.6%) but affiliated-fund carve-out deleted, "GP change" EOD added, and Steuart named. Clause (a) reads conjunctively (ownership AND board control)--helpful, confirm. Counter: D/TS definition, Permitted Holders include affiliated/successor funds under common management; delete (c). Fallback: 50% with Control test.
CoC2 Key Person EOD (S): CEO and CFO both depart within 6 months; TS: none. Counter: delete; fallback notice plus 180-day replacement "reasonably acceptable to Agent", no EOD, excludes death/disability.

MANDATORY PREPAYMENT
M1 Asset sales 75% to 100%, $10M/$25M to $5M/$10M, reinvestment 365 to 180 days (S). Fallback 75%, $7.5M/$15M, 270 days.
M2 Casualty 100%, no reinvestment (C): conflicts with pipeline restoration; D/TS 75% with reinvestment. Fallback reinvest right for restoration; prepay only above $15M if not committed in 365 days.
M3 ECF sweep 50/25/0 to 75/50/25 (S): by model ECF, extra sweep FY2028-30 about $48.8M (FY2029-30 sweep despite <2.5x). Hold.
M4 Extraordinary Receipts 100% over $2M (S): TS none; captures tax refunds, indemnities, settlements. Delete; fallback 50% over $10M, reinvestable.

CONSTRUCTION (Mountaineer Lateral)
C1 Deadline Mar 31, 2028 (C): TS buffer already three months (April 2028 base). Model Q1-Q2 2028 spend $2.45M. Restore June 30, 2028 plus 90-day force majeure.
C2 Overrun 110% ($341M) now automatic EOD (C): TS 115% ($356.5M); loses D 5.10(e) scope-reduction option. Restore.
C3 Delay prepayments $5M/month (cap $30M) and EOD at Sept 30, 2028 without cure (C): TS none. Base case misses Mar 31 by about a month, triggering $5M. "In addition to all other remedies" also leaves covenant EOD. Delete; fallback force majeure/permit delay relief and exclusive remedy.
C4 Completion Guaranty (C): CP, new rep, Loan Party/Security Document definitions, Exhibit E. Fund cannot: SL s.5(c); 66-2/3% LP consent; open-ended; $310M budget (overrun 15% = $46.5M) is uncapped. TS: no sponsor credit support. Reject. Fallback only with Steuart sign-off: capped equity contribution (SL s.5(d)(i) up to $50M) or limited payment guaranty ($25M); combined $75M exceeds $73M free capacity and counts toward cap. SL s.8 restricts disclosure; GP sign-off needed.
C5 Dual certification, Agent's advisor at Borrower cost (S): Redstone only; fallback Agent advisor reviews Redstone, cost cap.

REPORTING
Budget requires Required Lender approval (C): TS information only; operational control, lender-liability/DIP-style; delete; fallback delivery plus meeting. Deadlines audit 90, quarterly/budget 45 (S): hold 120/60; fallback 105/50. Monthly construction reports (A; TS suggests quarterly fallback; accept monthly, 30 days). Annual ESAs (S): delete; Phase I at closing only (TS), further only on reasonable cause. Regulatory correspondence 5 days (S): material only, 10 days. Semiannual reserve report (A).

EVENTS OF DEFAULT
MAE (C): adds "prospects", any obligations, lender rights; MAE EOD and rep bring-down at each draw let lenders halt construction draws. Restore D/TS (payment obligations); delete prospects; MAE EOD limited to payment ability.
Environmental EOD (C): any claim over $5M or $3M remediation order is immediate. Delete; fallback final unstayed order, uninsured over $15M, 60 days.
Permit-loss EOD (C): immediate, includes FERC; rep covers all permits now in force (construction-stage permits not yet issued; gathering lines are often FERC non-jurisdictional, unverified). Fallback: MAE-level loss uncured 90 days, appeals excluded.
Payment grace 5 to 3 days (S): restore 5 (fallback 3 for interest). Cross-default $25M to $15M (S): $20M, Guarantors only, acceleration-based. Judgment $25M to $10M, 30 days, no insurance carve-out (S): $20M/60 days. ERISA $15M (A).

VOTING
Required Lenders 66-2/3% (C): TS 50%; blocking minority one lender in a 5-7 bank group. Counter 50%. Financial covenants unanimous (C): TS majority; downturn amendments. Commitment increase unanimous (A). Agent "sole discretion" approval of yank-a-bank replacements (S): "not unreasonably withheld".

OTHER
Representations (S): $3M environmental, "prospects" MAE rep, ROW title, projections rep (A with D wording).

4. INTERACTIONS
(1) Addback deletion + 4.00x + fee shortfall: FY2027 breach (4.10x). (2) Addback deletion + 3.00x + ECF deletion + 75% sweep: distributions blocked longer, ECF cut. (3) Tier shift + addback deletion: construction at Level IV (+135 bps v. D). (4) Mar 31 deadline + prepayments + 110% EOD + no force majeure + guaranty. (5) MAE "any Loan Party" + Fund as Loan Party: Fund-level events default Ridgeline; plus draw conditions. (6) 66-2/3% + unanimous covenants + Agent veto: no downturn relief. (7) Fee ban + addback + SL accrual. (8) Casualty 100% + asset sweeps + Extraordinary Receipts + liquidity covenant.

5. NEXT STEPS
Escalate and obtain Redstone schedule; client call Oct 30 2:00 PM ET (Reinholt, Volkov, Steuart); obtain LP Agreement (unverified) and Steuart authority; reconcile model (fee, 4.2x v. 3.94x, notes maturity); counter-markup to Graymark Nov 7 to hold Dec 15 closing.
